**Calculations:**

The increase in the number of seats won by AGP in 2019 compared to 2014 is

⇒ 303 - 282

⇒ 21

The percentage increase in the number of seats won by AGP in 2019 compared to 2014 is

⇒ ((Increase space in space no. of space seats space wonspace by space AGP))/(No.space ofspace seatsspace space wonspace by space AGP space space in space 2014)× 100

⇒ (21)/(282) × 100

⇒ 7.45 %

**therefore The percentage increase in the number of seats won by AGP in the year 2019 is 7.45%.**
